find: if (state.boot === 'holding') return 'the boot holding card, which has no application in it yet';
why: Sweeps the holding card for menu hit targets. There is no application in the page at all -- the module is deliberately never served -- so the collector runs against served markup and finds nothing, spending a browser launch inside a required check to learn it. The exclusion is keyed on `boot` rather than on the id so a future state that holds the module inherits it; deleting the clause is what proves the keying matters.
killedBy: hit-sweep.mjs: which surfaces the visual gate sweeps excludes exactly the developer, startup-failure, no-script, match-failure and played-ending states, each for its rule
